title: Video 2: Step through XSLT and XPath
steps: Set a breakpoint on the variable's line, and click Debug

steps.caption: Step Into: through a multi-line XPath expression, line by line
steps.note: F11, or the Step Into button

steps.caption: Hover over a variable or a path to see its value
steps.note: Or watch it in the Variables view

steps: Continue to a fold-left with an inline function
Step Into: even into inline functions
Step Over: watch $largest change for each line

steps.caption: A conditional breakpoint: pause only when it matters
steps.note: Right-click in the margin: Add Conditional Breakpoint, e.g. @customer = 'Grace'

steps.caption: A logpoint: print debugging without changing the stylesheet

steps: Each line logged in the Debug Console, without pausing

steps.caption: Step Back: go back to where you were
steps.note: Or Reverse Continue to the last breakpoint

steps: Step through XSLT and XPath, with any SaxonJ edition
